suggested_snapshot_fields_to_add.why: Normalized union of all cells actually affected by the option, so exact-cell and predicted-landing checks do not need to inspect target/ray/line/AOE fields separately.
Provides engine-ranked likely landing cells for fast movers, reducing misses where current hex is targeted instead of the destination.
Gives a normalized action class such as move, fast_move, attack_ray, attack_aoe for deterministic rule application and attack-vs-move preference.
Unifies target/affected/ray/line/intercept coverage into one engine-computed array so exact-cell and landing-cell checks are deterministic.
Provides engine-computed likely landing cells for fast movers so the planner targets landings instead of guessing from current position.
Directly marks which legal attacks intercept predicted enemy landings, simplifying the attack-over-move rule.
Expose engine-computed likely landing cells for enemies that can move before friendly attacks resolve, so the planner does not have to infer them from prose.
Provide one normalized list of every cell the option would hit/cover, regardless of attack metadata shape, making landing-cell checks deterministic.
Makes the fast-mover rule precise by telling the planner when it must target predicted landing cells instead of current positions.
Normalized union of every cell the option ends on or can affect; removes ambiguity across target_cell/affected_cells/ray_cells/line_cells/intercept_cells.
Provides all legal move/fast_move landing cells directly so the planner can identify predicted landing cells without reconstructing them from raw options.
Precomputed per-option interception info makes landing-cell attack checks deterministic and cheap.
